verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows an HTTP/WebSocket API, official Python and Node.js SDKs, an llms.txt, and an official MCP server. None of it documents an official command-line tool for ElevenLabs Scribe. SDKs and the MCP server are developer building blocks or different integration surfaces, not a CLI, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
